title: Extend bounded HIA selfhosting and repair ABI, CFG, cold replay, release and NDU gates
body:
## Current status

**HOLD until the required CI for this exact head passes.** Current head is [ffa64c93](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/commit/ffa64c93dd4c51190fda8c0f647481a31ffbcf07), tree `67fd66a7690ab007368ade7a7674ab7c82ac19fe`. This child of `14b2c03c` repairs both retained CI failures and includes the complete local qualification described below. It is not a merged-source CI result, a published default lock, or an online activation.

The previous head finished 17 of 19 workflows successfully. Its exact-source cold replay failed at the original 180-second deadline, and one initialization execution test failed before its marker became durable. Both original runs, their successful controls, intermediate errors and final local repairs remain separately retained. No run was retried or substituted to erase these failures.

## Why and resulting behavior

This PR extends the bounded native HIA compiler through v13 and repairs concrete issues found during its qualification and review. The explicit ELF profile covers all 50 Core **operation names**; flat output covers 40. It includes checked bulk operations, borrowed lifetimes, owned buffers and six chain operations, with strict ownership and graph-join checks. This is not complete general Core support.

| Defect | Resulting behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Optional `alloc` effect omitted from the native structural node count | Count it in every native parse pass; retain exact-limit and one-over controls with and without the effect. |
| Machine-plan oracle expected 16 workspace header words | Require exact equality for all 17 observed words, including word 248; retain missing/altered/extra-field refusals. |
| Stopped borrowed entries were rejected because caller-owned roots were absent from Core heap ownership | Retain the actual trap or budget stop, caller bytes and active local loan without counting external roots as Core-owned heap. |
| Backward CFG discovery repeatedly reparsed the entire source | Schedule pending blocks by source offset while preserving strict SSA and resource-lifetime checks; retain the original slow/CPU-limit cases and intermediate rejection. |
| NDU replay did not validate the reported paired timing analysis | Recompute all paired differences and statistics from retained cell ledgers; preserve the original corrupted-analysis acceptance and repaired refusal. |
| Cold qualification exceeded 180 seconds on one CI host | Keep the fresh B0 and all dependent original/modified generations sequential, then schedule 20 independent groups of checks in at most two fresh workers. Keep all 1,183 checks, 1,699 native calls and individual resource limits. |
| The cold timeout path did not establish descendant cleanup, and the checkpoint test's durability assertion depended on startup scheduling | Add a dedicated Linux subreaper with positive cleanup admission; make only the checkpoint test clock depend on the actual durable marker while retaining its finite readiness negative control and unchanged production deadlines. |

The cold owner is isolated from its caller. It covers ordinary descendants in other sessions, preserves unreaped PID identity before signaling, and requires kernel `ECHILD` plus no remaining direct children. **180 seconds remains the qualification budget; a separate maximum of three seconds is only for cleanup.** A late report or unconfirmed cleanup cannot pass. `OWNER_UNCONFIRMED_HOLD` may still have live processes and is explicitly not successful cleanup or a security-sandbox claim.

The complete closed phase inventory, source/input hashes, fresh worker PID and strict boolean results are verified. Every future is observed, including exceptions before launch; missing, duplicate, unknown or overwritten phase results cannot pass.

## Current local qualification and retained evidence

The compiler remains `b6062d03a72079de32b5a3ebbebb66d575297b9b89b1625f5a6b42cba9432168`; all 212 `hepta/` Python files in the previous head's selfhost closure are unchanged. The final **252-file closure** is byte-identical across the main, cold, nested-cold and language reports and root's integration check.

| Qualification | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Source, contract, language inventory, phase protocol and owner controls | 39 distinct methods validated. Initial 38 PASS/1 missing-local-fixture import error retained; only that method was rerun after restoring the exact existing fixture. |
| Fresh main native qualification | **1,183/1,183 PASS**, 88.129021575 s |
| Finite comparison with original successful CI | Same 1,183 check map, same 1,699-call logical inventory, non-path request inputs and selected behavior fields; all six B/M generation hashes unchanged |
| Changed existing report assertions | **2/2 PASS** against the retained actual report; no duplicate native run |
| Fresh source-only cold replay | **11/11 PASS**, 88.084033772 s; original ten checks plus explicit cleanup |
| Cold nested qualification | **1,183/1,183 PASS**, 87.168068504 s |
| Actual cold owner | Leader/supervisor exit zero; cleanup 0.000718163 s; `ECHILD`, leader reaped, no remaining child or cleanup error |
| Fresh language qualification | **910/910 PASS**, 65.057833179 s |
| Checkpoint execution suite | Exact original **42/42** inventory passes; original controlled failure, delayed-start/fsync controls and bounded missing-marker refusal retained |
| Root release inventory suite | **18/18 PASS**; new helper/test/docs required by release, source CI and public installation |
| Workflow static validation | 17 shell steps and seven embedded Python programs parsed |

These are separate reports and suites; their counts are not summed as unique tests. Earlier native qualifications remain historical evidence for their own exact source snapshots.

The comparison retains **279 differing host-linked shared-object hashes** (121 seed-shared, 130 linked-selfhost, 28 allocator witnesses). The old CI used GNU ld 2.42/Python 3.12.16 and the local host used GNU ld 2.44/Python 3.12.14. Matching finite observations and the compiler-produced generation hashes do not establish general cross-toolchain equivalence or compiler performance improvement.

Primary current evidence:

- [Cold scheduling/ownership repair](docs/HIA_SELFHOST_COLD_PARALLEL_OWNER_FIX_20261108.md) and [full delivery](review-evidence/hia-selfhost-cold-parallel-20261108-5e6c/delivery.json): four complete archives, all members independently rehashed. Main 12,148 files; cold 12,408; language 8,300; support 6,619.
- [Owner lifecycle controls](docs/HIA_SELFHOST_COLD_PROCESS_OWNER_20261108.md): seven real harmless Python-process controls; original executor-capability refusal retained.
- [Checkpoint repair](review-evidence/hia-diagnostic-capture-checkpoint-20261108-5e6c/README.md): production capture source unchanged.
- [Root integration](review-evidence/hia-ci14b-root-integration-20261108-5e6c/final-integration.json): 252 actual source hashes, registrations and exact public-entry helper/document parity.
- [Original 14b NDU artifact](review-evidence/hia-ndu-14b-ci-20261108-5e6c/README.md): all 475 original members, 172 Python tests, three Rust framing controls and both complete 72-cell campaigns retained.

The two original cold CI ZIPs had the same **250 actual source members / 5,243,162 bytes**, verified byte for byte. Their retained selection includes 6,317 original requests/receipts. The failure at 180.127351883 s and successful control at 119.995411250 s both remain; the failed run's historical descendant cleanup is not retroactively asserted.

## Proof, Agent and NDU boundaries

The supplied-artifact machine checker additionally models the existing producer's 64-bit register-register CMOVNE leaf within the unchanged Safe Core profile. Its 13 valid SMT cases, six SAT refutations, three unsupported cases, native witnesses, solver queries and checker identity remain scoped evidence. They do not prove the full compiler, general ABI/resources/FFI/ISA or loader behavior.

The frozen original unfamiliar-Agent select extension has strict replay evidence. Its C0 rejects an input that C1 accepts, so unconditional all-input behavioral equivalence cannot describe that extension. The existing required claims remain unproved, evaluation remains refused, and no adoption is claimed. A successful same-Core lifecycle is a different subject. Original full provider interactions and billing remain unavailable.

The repaired prepared NDU replayer recomputes all analysis from the original ledgers. In the retained 14b campaign, ordinary scalar controls still beat prepared and persistent transport in all 24 pairs. Horizon-one persistence varied across retained runs. Model cost is null, full cost is incomplete and **P2 remains HOLD**. No transport-cost reduction is promoted to economic value.

## CI, publication and online gates

1. Validate this exact PR head in required source, unified, NDU and other applicable workflows; retain every failure.
2. Merge into `codex/hia-sixgap-source-6d5c-20261108`, then obtain the **merged source's original successful CI release lock**.
3. Publish the separate metadata/default-entry update to `main`; its default lock must equal that original source-CI artifact byte for byte. Run public installation CI on the actual metadata commit.
4. Prepare the exact candidate, qualify its actual runtime entry, complete the guarded operational transition and capture fresh formal `h` manifest readback against the published lock.

The source and metadata commit identities are intentionally different. This PR must **not** be retargeted to the metadata-only `main` tree. Private deployment material is not in this source PR. Future v14 fixtures/implementation are also not included in this frozen v13 qualification.

## Six-track acceptance

| Track | Current boundary |
| --- | --- |
| Release consistency | Public entry engineering and local preparation established; final merged-source lock, metadata installation and new online identity remain pending. |
| Proof semantics | Subject/property/profile/assumptions/trusted components/nonclaims remain explicit; no global safety statement. |
| Complete Core selfhosting | Bounded v13 operation coverage and native evidence established; general Core remains open. |
| Machine proof | Scoped independent artifact results established; whole compiler and general execution obligations remain open. |
| Unfamiliar Agent task | Real frozen task and strict refusals retained; missing semantic/lowering claims and full provider evidence remain open. |
| NDU value | Integration and mechanism arithmetic validated; stable incremental value and economic benefit unproved. |

**Overall acceptance remains HOLD.**
